review: 701.25a-1: the decisions had A surveil before the trigger resolved; reordered so the surveil happens on resolution.

701.25c-1: the one-artifact expectation had the Snitch trigger resolve before Cerebral Download's draw; the draw happens during resolution and the trigger resolves afterwards. Added the decision that resolves the trigger.

scenarios.title: Surveil 2 puts chosen cards into the graveyard and leaves the rest on top
decisions: A passes priority with an empty stack.
B casts Terror targeting Citywatch Sphinx, tapping Swamp and Swamp.
Both players pass; Terror resolves and Citywatch Sphinx dies.
Citywatch Sphinx's trigger goes on the stack; both players pass.
The trigger resolves: A surveils 2, looks at Forest and Mountain, puts Forest into the graveyard and Mountain on top.

variants.label: one-to-graveyard
variants.expected: A's graveyard holds Citywatch Sphinx and Forest. A's library is Mountain, Island from the top.

variants.label: keep-both
variants.delta: A keeps both cards on top, in their current order.
variants.expected: A's graveyard holds only Citywatch Sphinx. A's library is Forest, Mountain, Island from the top.

operation.unclassifiable: The player's surveil choice changes; no fork operation changes a player's decision.

variants.label: both-to-graveyard
variants.delta: A puts both Forest and Mountain into the graveyard.
variants.expected: A's graveyard holds Citywatch Sphinx, Forest and Mountain. A's library is Island.

operation.unclassifiable: The player's surveil choice changes; no fork operation changes a player's decision.

detector.outcome: A surveil resolution moves cards from the top of the library to the graveyard.
detector.near_miss: A surveil resolution that moved no card.

scenarios.title: Surveil 0 is not a surveil event

setup.notes: Library lists are top first. A controls no artifact.

decisions: A casts Cerebral Download, tapping five Islands.
Both players pass; Cerebral Download resolves.
A surveils X, X being the number of artifacts A controls, keeping any looked-at card on top.
If Whispering Snitch triggers, both players pass and the trigger resolves.

variants.label: zero-artifacts
variants.expected: A surveils 0: no surveil event occurs and Whispering Snitch does not trigger. A draws three Forests; life totals stay 20 and 20.

variants.label: one-artifact
variants.expected: A surveils 1, keeping the Forest on top, and draws three Forests. Whispering Snitch triggers and its trigger resolves after Cerebral Download: B takes 1 damage (19) and A gains 1 life (21).

operation.unclassifiable: A permanent is added to the battlefield; no fork operation adds a permanent.

detector.outcome: A trigger on surveilling fires when a player surveils 1 or more.
detector.near_miss: A surveil trigger evaluated against a surveil it does not watch (another player's, or not the first this turn) does not fire; a surveil 0 is no surveil event and evaluates no trigger at all.

scenarios.title: A surveil trigger fires even if no card could be moved

setup.notes: A's library is empty. B's Plains is used only in the last variant.

decisions: A passes priority with an empty stack.
B casts Terror targeting Citywatch Sphinx, tapping Swamp and Swamp.
Both players pass; Terror resolves and Citywatch Sphinx dies.
Its trigger surveils 2 on A's empty library.
Whispering Snitch's trigger goes on the stack and resolves.

variants.label: empty-library
variants.expected: The surveil looks at no card and moves nothing, and Whispering Snitch triggers: B takes 1 damage (19) and A gains 1 life (21).

variants.label: two-cards
variants.delta: A's library holds Forest and Forest, and A puts both into the graveyard.
variants.expected: Both Forests move to A's graveyard after Citywatch Sphinx, then Whispering Snitch triggers: B 19, A 21.

operation.unclassifiable: The library gains two cards and the player's surveil choice is set; no fork operation changes a library or a decision.

variants.label: no-death
variants.delta: B's hand holds Swords to Plowshares instead of Terror, and B casts it targeting Citywatch Sphinx, tapping Plains.
variants.expected: Citywatch Sphinx is exiled and does not die, so no surveil occurs and Whispering Snitch does not trigger. A gains 5 life (25) from Swords to Plowshares and B stays at 20.

operation.unclassifiable: B holds and casts a different spell, with another land; no fork operation changes a hand or the spell cast.

scenarios.forge_notes: A's library is empty throughout; A must not draw during the scenario.

detector.outcome: A trigger on surveilling fires after a surveil completes, even if no card could be looked at or moved.
detector.near_miss: A surveil trigger evaluated against a surveil it does not watch (another player's, or not the first this turn) does not fire.
